Print method for svmodt_node objects

Source: R/svmodt_classes.R
print.svmodt_node.Rd

Print method for svmodt_node objects

# S3 method for class 'svmodt_node'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

An object of class svmodt_node.

...

Further arguments passed to print_svm_tree.

Examples

tree <- svm_split(
  data = wdbc,
  response = "diagnosis",
  max_features = 2,
  max_depth = 3,
  min_samples = 5,
  feature_method = "random",
  verbose = TRUE
)
